OwnerFields:
      title: Owner fields
      description: Editable fields of a pet owner.
      type: object
      properties:
        firstName:
          title: First name
          description: The first name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}$"
          example: George
        lastName:
          title: Last name
          description: The last name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}\\.?$"
          example: Franklin
        address:
          title: Address
          description: The postal address of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 255
          example: '110 W. Liberty St.'
        city:
          title: City
          description: The city of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 80
          example: Madison
        telephone:
          title: Telephone number
          description: The telephone number of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 20
          pattern: '^[0-9]*$'
          example: '6085551023'
      required:
        - firstName
        - lastName
        - address
        - city
        - telephone
    Owner:
      title: Owner
      description: A pet owner.
      allOf:
        - $ref: '#/components/schemas/OwnerFields'
        - type: object
          properties:
            id:
              title: ID
              description: The ID of the pet owner.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            pets:
              title: Pets
              description: The pets owned by this individual including any booked vet visits.
              type: array
              items:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/Pet'

## Summary

The change rejects creating an owner that is missing or blank in any of `firstName`, `lastName`, `address`, `city`, or `telephone`, responding with **400** and a JSON body whose `errors` array lists each offending field. Two complementary paths were needed because the OpenAPI-generated `OwnerFieldsDto` only carries `@NotNull @Size(min=1)` (plus a pattern on some fields):

1. **Missing / empty / pattern-violating values** already trip Bean Validation (`@Valid` on the generated `addOwner` interface) → `MethodArgumentNotValidException`. I updated `ExceptionControllerAdvice.handleMethodArgumentNotValidException` to add an `errors` property listing the distinct rejected field names.

2. **Whitespace-only values** for `address`/`city` slip past `@Size(min=1)` entirely. I added `validateRequiredFields(...)` to `OwnerRestControllerV1.addOwner` that trims and checks all five fields, throwing a new `InvalidOwnerFieldsException(List<String> fields)`. A dedicated handler in the advice turns it into the same 400 + `errors` array shape.

Files changed:
- `rest/advice/InvalidOwnerFieldsException.java` (new) — carries the offending field names.
- `rest/advice/ExceptionControllerAdvice.java` — added the `errors` array to the bean-validation 400 response and a handler for the new exception.
- `rest/controller/v1/OwnerRestControllerV1.java` — blank/missing field validation in `addOwner`.

Verified: the provided tests (missing city, blank telephone, valid owner) pass, and a throwaway test confirmed whitespace-only `address`+`city` are both rejected and listed in `errors` (then removed).
